acceptance.source: Immutable owner-scoped raw headers/rows; server-verified SHA-256 canonical identity and per-chunk checksum; changed source or initial mapping cannot reuse job identity. Invalid cells remain staged for inspection/correction.
acceptance.corrections: Durable mapping revisions and typed row overlays affect only unprocessed rows. Replacements retire superseded history; accepted batches and raw source are unchanged. Exact correction receipts survive restart; changed operation input conflicts.
acceptance.preview: Current source batch, canonical identity, correction revision, job version/progress, JSON target schema/import declaration and existing target versions bind each reviewed batch. Server recomputation inside SQLite prevents forged or stale acceptance. Only declared import fields appear in before/after values.
acceptance.upsert: Declared scalar non-null unique identity; exactly one authorized owner-scoped match. Ambiguous matches and repeated batch keys fail explicitly. Updates preserve unmapped fields; inserts use the full schema/defaults. Invalid batches write no targets or progress.
acceptance.authority: Current auth/owner fences on every new route and client response; unowned reads and writes require explicit policies. Read policy precedes existing values, and write policy checks original/proposed values. Exact replay rechecks current target access. Async policies fail closed with rejected promises contained.
acceptance.atomic: Target writes, cursor/counters, corrections and exact accepted result receipts commit together. Two actual process kills after target/receipt writes roll back the complete boundary. Lost initial response with a stable creation key resumes one job; lost update response replays once after restart. Independent connections accept one exact operation.
acceptance.integrations: Source-linked search success projects current imported versions; capacity failure rolls back target rows, index, job progress and receipt.
acceptance.retention: Bounded global jobs/chunks/staging, source bytes, target lookup/final insert count, correction rows/bytes and receipt rows/bytes. Completion/cancellation purges raw/correction payloads and document-history copies in pages, while source identities/job metadata/operation receipts remain. Admission rejects instead of dropping replay protection.
acceptance.browser: Actual file chooser/HTTP/SQLite flow verifies invalid preview, saved mapping/value corrections, explicit before/after review, stale version rejection and acceptance. Keyboard focus is restored after disabled actions, long values fit 390px, account/disposal responses are discarded and detected session revocation clears already displayed source. New upload control retains a creation key while mounted.

consumerTypes.legacyStructuralClient: Positive fixture implements the unchanged streaming-only DurableImportClient.

hostedInitial.test: controller SIGKILL stops canary writers before immediate startup admits the prior release
hostedInitial.diagnosis: SELECT-only readOnly observer cannot recover a hot rollback journal left by SIGKILL. SQLite reference: https://www.sqlite.org/rescode.html#readonly_rollback
hostedInitial.fix: Use a writable SELECT-only observer in native and disposable Docker fixtures. Added a deterministic real process kill after dirty-page spill; readOnly fails with 776, writable observation recovers original rows and integrity. Runtime fencing assertions and isolation remain unchanged. Docker remains unexecuted without a disposable host.

earlierChecks.reason: Passed before the additional displayed-source revocation regression, stable upload key and resource/compatibility tests.
Passed before separating the additive ReviewableImportClient from the unchanged legacy structural interface.

compatibility.default: Streaming insert-only methods/outputs remain available. DurableImportClient structural implementations need no review methods; the factory returns its additive ReviewableImportClient subtype. Legacy routes cannot apply reviewable raw chunks.
compatibility.migration: Opt-in owned correction/operation tables plus defaulted job metadata/chunk checksums. Defaulted job/chunk metadata is shared by all upgraded import writers; review-only correction/operation tables remain opt-in. Streaming-only handles inspect review jobs but cannot cancel/retry/apply them. Register feature schema before a PITR seal; the existing recovery guard remains.
compatibility.definition: Drain/finish/cancel jobs before changing their import target JSON schema, fields, uniqueness, duplicate policy or batch size. Definition drift fails closed; direct SQL and older writers of reviewable metadata are unsupported.
compatibility.rollback: Finish/cancel reviewable jobs, drain writers and unmount their controls. Retain job/source identity and operation receipts; use the upgraded importer to inspect them. Ordinary CRUD remains usable.
compatibility.dependencies: No npm dependencies or new distribution files; unchanged 395-file/6 MiB gates.

boundaries.identity: Canonical parsed data is attested, not verbatim CSV file bytes. Equivalent quoting/line endings can share identity.
boundaries.privateSource: Raw source belongs to its uploading account; target read policy controls existing target values. Workspace/account navigation must dispose/remount controls.
boundaries.creationRetry: Custom callers must supply a stable key to recover an unknown initial create response. Default keys represent new imports. Widget keys persist while mounted.
boundaries.receiptResult: Exact results describe their original acceptance; inspect for current progress. Deleted/revoked target access denies receipt retrieval. Capacity limits deliberately reject work rather than expire retry identities.
boundaries.queryBounds: Responses at most 1 MiB, correction/result records 64 KiB, canonical source 16 MiB, browser files 5 MiB/50000 rows. Smaller batches/windows are required for large values. Index unique fields for efficient bounded lookup.
boundaries.physicalRetention: Logical current payload limits do not erase SQLite/WAL/independent archived bytes. Metadata/receipt tombstones stay admitted under global bounds; retention administration remains feature39.
boundaries.host: Three privileged Docker/XFS skips remain, not certification.
